comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: A green colored version of this (color-customizable) outfit is available until April 8th for completing the Ex-Pastry Thief's Dungeon Raid side quest in Veracruz. Each time you complete the side quest successfully, her Mood level rises by a certain amount (20 for easy difficulty level, and higher for medium/hard); get it to 100, and the outfit, as well as the wardrobe box related to the main St. Patrick's Event, is yours.
